name: Watervliet
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Watervliet, NY
blurb: The last tidal water below the federal dam at Troy. Above the dam the river is locked and the tide stops.

tide.label: NOAA TEC1603 Troy
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station TEC1603 at Troy, about a mile upriver.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.
